when_used: Only when the card's video model (price menu, F14 lock) is a Kling video model instead of Hailuo 02 Standard. Never for lip-sync: the lip-sync model is OmniHuman 2.0 (omnihuman-2-0) on every run and takes no prompt (N-08, S-42).
section_order: Same order as minimax-h3.json, compressed: header, subject, action, reference, camera, lens_light, continuity, look, book, pages, physics, beats, policy, negatives.
differences_from_h3: No bracket camera syntax: Kling takes the move in plain words, placed AFTER the subject's motion (file 17: 'Add camera movement after subject movement').
Look block uses the mode's kling_block (short form, about 350-450 characters), not the h3_block.
Negatives stay inside the prompt: the 67 catalog shows no negative_prompt control field for these KIE entries. Use a separate negative_prompt field only if a later catalog row lists it.
Band: 1,800-2,500 target (Kling recommends 2,500 or less); hard max from the catalog (3,072 omni, 2,500 for 3.0/video and 2.5 turbo).
Duration: kling-3.0-omni 3-15 s; 2.5 turbo 5 or 10 s only.

prompt_hygiene.source: F-LETTER-PROMPT, the Kling story-clip half. The Kling avatar template and its wording-B prompt rule are retired for lip-sync (N-08, S-42); the Kling video models above are still a card choice, so their prompts keep the hygiene rule.
prompt_hygiene.no_signage_strings: No text, words, lettering or signage strings anywhere in a Kling prompt: no shop signs, billboards, posters, captions, titles, doodles, labels, logos, or decor words that invite the provider to burn letters into the frame. A Kling story clip is animated from its checked keyframe, so any real writing the shot needs is already in that keyframe and is never re-asked of the model in words.
prompt_hygiene.no_text_clause: Keep the explicit no-new-text clause in the prompt: 'no new writing, no captions, no logo, no watermark; any writing already in the start picture stays exactly as it is.'
prompt_hygiene.negative_field: The 67 catalog lists no negative_prompt control for these KIE entries, so a separate negative prompt is not sent; the no-text clause lives in the prompt itself. If a later catalog row lists negative_prompt, add 'text, words, letters, signage, captions, watermark, logo' there and keep the in-prompt clause too.
forbidden: quoted spoken or sung words in a story-clip prompt
a 4-word or longer run copied from the line's lyric
decor words that name signage or title lettering the model must draw
